inner_arch: The Aglaura that is spoken has all the compact solidity needed to exist—even though its ancient proverbial virtues, faults, eccentricities, and rules have inverted over time so nothing said of it is true—whereas the colorless Aglaura planted at random on the ground exists less; and when at certain twilight hours, in certain street openings, the unmistakable suspicion of something rare and magnificent opens before your eyes, you cannot say it because every word is already imprisoned inside spoken Aglaura, obliging repetition and erasing the unworded recollection.

stones.contract: At ordinary hours (IX Forenoon, XII Midday, XX Dusk), ground-Aglaura renders as a colorless, characterless city planted at random with low ontological substance (< 0.30).
Spoken Aglaura comprises 8 canonical ancient accounts across proverbial virtues, proverbial faults, eccentricities, and punctilious rules, repeated identically by inhabitants and travelers.

Each canonical account exposes both its ancient observer attribution and its present-day inversion (bizarre became usual, normal became extravagance, virtues/faults lost merit or dishonor), proving nothing said of Aglaura is true today while remaining solid and compact.
Spoken Aglaura maintains high ontological solidity (>= 0.92), whereas ground-Aglaura and haphazard present-day opinions hold far less substance.

Across 6 street openings, holding silent unworded observation during the 3 liminal 'certain hours' (XVI Oblique Vespers, XVIII Suspended Gloaming, V Pale Daybreak Cleft) parts the colorless fog into a rare, magnificent golden vista (epiphanyIntensity -> 1.0).

Attempting to speak, type-submit, or name any observation passes through <word-imprisonment-lock>, clamping every free word into one of the 8 verbatim ancient proverbs (freeWordsSurvived === 0, obligedToRepeat === true).

Gesture-safe muteable WebAudio synthesizes unison choral-formant chant + iron-gall seal snap upon utterance imprisonment, contrasting with fragile crystalline harmonics during silent ground epiphanies.

Speaking a ground glimpse immediately overwrites and erases that street opening's living visual memory (epiphanyIntensity -> 0, status -> 'lost_for_lack_of_words', lostRecollectionsCount++), leaving only spoken Aglaura expressible.

hard_gates.HG-1: 100% standalone index.html (0 http/https URLs, 0 ../ refs, 0 fetch, 0 syntax/console/page errors, clean 1280x800 desktop & 390x844 mobile with 0 horizontal overflow, prefers-reduced-motion respected, [hidden] strictly display:none).
